row.notes: Vtable init of a lap/sector timing helper: main/pit TrackSpace spline lengths -> this+0x150/+0x154; start position lap distance (Game_TrackSpace_FindVolume/LapDistance) -> +0x158; sector list from track data ([this+0x20]+0x28)+0x60..+0x68 (stride 0x10). If the track does not have exactly 3 sectors it traces 'Found %d sectors but was expecting %d' and falls back to 3 equal thirds of the lap length (list this+0x1b0). Also uses the ghost component and Car_Setup_ApplyTuning. Track modding: custom tracks must mark up exactly 3 sectors or the splits are fake thirds. | #587: L2 by lead-authorised promotion for lane owner re-career-teams (independent agree V2881) engine-re round B 2026-11-17 (static): the 3 sectors come from MarkupElements whose Attribute Type is exactly sector_1 / sector_2 / sector_3 (Game_TrackSpace_LoadXml -> Game_TrackMarkup_AddSector_Thunk); a Type 'sector' is dropped by the loader. The function also reads pit_lim_on (type 16) and ai_pit_trigger (type 19) items of the markup (byte-size checks < 0x261 and > 0x200, lists +0x268 and +0x208).
